description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class for handling operations related to Workflow State Machines in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting workflow state machine records, as well as checking permissions for actions within workflows.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDao
classes.description: A DAO class that provides methods for managing workflow state machine records in the database, enabling retrieval, creation, update, and deletion operations for the WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves allowed actions for a given workflow, optional state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Fetches workflow items matching the specified workflow, optional state, and role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Determines the next state in a workflow given current state, role, and action.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Fetches workflow state machines that are actionable for a specific workflow, role, and set of actions.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Saves a WorkflowStateMachine entity to the database.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists an array of WorkflowStateMachine entities.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on workflow, state, role, action, and resulting state.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes all workflow records for a given user role, optionally filtered by workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates the role name in all workflow state machine records where the old role appears.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Fetches all allowed recruitment application states for a specific workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow state machine records for a given workflow, optionally filtered by role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is permitted in a given workflow state, role, and action.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Fetches a WorkflowStateMachine entity by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a specific workflow state machine record based on workflow, state, role, and action.
